name: MAG
recent: MAG Holdings Berhad 近期只有董事在闭门期内的交易意向申报，以及一份未说明内容的「OTHERS」公告。新闻方面，公司 2026 年上半年净利同比下滑 48.4% 至 RM13.3 million，主要受物流成本与汇率波动影响。
notable: 2026 年上半年净利同比下滑 48.4% 至 RM13.3 million。
执行主席 Ng Min Lin 及两名非独立非执行董事在闭门期内申报有意买卖公司证券。
risks: 物流成本与汇率波动压缩赚幅，导致 2026 年上半年净利同比下滑 48.4%。
董事在闭门期内申报有意交易公司股份。
earnings: 最新财报（2025-12-31）营收 RM101.5 million，净亏损 RM239.8 million，净利率 -236.2%；营收环比下降 15.1%，净利环比下降 2521.7%，由上一期净利率 8.3% 转为亏损。

recent_en: MAG Holdings Berhad recently only had directors' intention-to-deal notices during closed periods and an 'OTHERS' announcement with unspecified content. In the news, the company's 1H26 net profit fell 48.4% year-on-year to RM13.3 million, mainly due to logistics costs and forex volatility.
notable_en: 1H26 net profit fell 48.4% year-on-year to RM13.3 million.
Executive Chairman Ng Min Lin and two non-independent non-executive directors notified intention to deal in company securities during closed periods.
risks_en: Logistics costs and forex volatility squeezed margins, causing 1H26 net profit to fall 48.4% year-on-year.
Directors notified intention to trade company shares during closed periods.
earnings_en: Latest financials (2025-12-31) show revenue of RM101.5 million and a net loss of RM239.8 million, with a net margin of -236.2%; revenue fell 15.1% QoQ and net income dropped 2521.7% QoQ, swinging from a prior net margin of 8.3% to a loss.
